Name: (CP) Bela's Nyapu Penny Edit
Author: Belavula
Description:
This mod was made for personal use, I'm mostly uploading it for ease. Incorporating it into my friend's games for multiplayer, etc. Feel free to use it, edit it, etc! It's a recolor of Nyapu's inspired Portrait mods as well as a personally recolored Sprite for Penny's usual, Beach, and Winter outfits. If I missed anything or didn't color the sprites well enough, you're welcome to tweak them.

My original edit of Penny was turning her into a light brunette to better match her yellow shirt (and slightly reduce the number of redheaded Bachelorettes in Stardew Valley, not that there's anything wrong with being a redhead. Just personally prefer some variety and there wasn't a brunette bachelorette that tickled my fancy.

This time around I made a Penny that looks a bit more like her mom. I tried to match the eyes and have a similar hair color, with a pale blue shirt instead of the traditional yellow. Thought the edit was cute, I may still upload a brunette version, but not lately.

Please forgo liking my download, it's a poor change from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Mod[/url], and they deserve all the praise and follows for their work. Thank you~
